say:1:1730204601:1.text: *Squeak* There are two bird guys over there! I think they're going to eat me!
say:1:1730204601:1.source_cn: 吱吱，前面有个鹰形的人，看起来很想吃鼠鼠！
say:1:1730204601:1.male: *Squeak* There are two bird guys over there! I think they're going to eat me!
say:1:1730204601:1.female: *Squeak* There are two bird guys over there! I think they're going to eat me!

say:2:1730204602:1.text: *Squeak* If I hadn't been fast, I'd be sliced and diced by now!
say:2:1730204602:1.source_cn: 吱吱，要不是鼠鼠跑得快，鼠鼠不知道要成为鼠条还是鼠片！
say:2:1730204602:1.male: *Squeak* If I hadn't been fast, I'd be sliced and diced by now!
say:2:1730204602:1.female: *Squeak* If I hadn't been fast, I'd be sliced and diced by now!

say:3:1730204603:1.text: *Squeak* Can't talk now! I need to keep running!
say:3:1730204603:1.source_cn: 吱吱，不跟你说了！鼠鼠要继续逃跑了！
say:3:1730204603:1.male: *Squeak* Can't talk now! I need to keep running!
say:3:1730204603:1.female: *Squeak* Can't talk now! I need to keep running!
